done.comment: Description clear, but the tape was never visible in 6 days of notes; its truth was 'top drawer of the office desk (out of sight)'. I reasoned to 'the office desk, inside the tote or a drawer' and answered 'putaway office|office desk' - the tool ACCEPTED that (a furniture key, not a spot) and scored it wrong instead of rejecting it or asking which spot. Spot ids are never printed: 'plan' shows spot names ('top drawer') but not an id I can type; 'help' says '<spot id>' without format. Even with the right syntax, choosing the top drawer out of four closed desk drawers (plus the tote bag) is a 1-in-5 guess with no evidence at all: nothing ever showed where the tape is kept. Suggest: give credit at furniture level for put-away answers, or have a patrol/look ever show it in use, or don't ask about things never seen.
